normalization_plan.reason: _owner is only a lookup key parameter of balanceOf (and the equivalent allowance lookup), it has no independent state and can be merged into the balanceOf function node
_to is the recipient parameter consumed by transfer and only influences the transfer balance updates
_value is the amount parameter directly feeding the unchecked arithmetic performed by transfer, so it merges into the transfer function node
_from is the debit address parameter used only inside transferFrom
_spender is only used as the second allowance key in approve (and the identical approveAndCall), so it merges into approve
_initialAmount is only used inside the constructor to set totalSupply and the initial balance
_tokenName is only assigned to the name state variable inside the constructor
_decimalUnits is only assigned to the decimals state variable inside the constructor
_tokenSymbol is only assigned to the symbol state variable inside the constructor
success is the boolean return local of transfer (and of transferFrom/approve) and carries no security relevant state, so it merges into the transfer function node
balance is the return local of balanceOf, merge into balanceOf
remaining is the return local of allowance, merge into allowance
